title: Checkout Testing
seo: Checkout and payment testing after changes
meta: Test orders and payment checks that show your checkout works on phones and desktops after every change. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
overview: A checkout that fails costs you sales before you notice. We place test orders in your store the way shoppers do, using different products, shipping options, discount codes and payment methods, on both phone and desktop. We check order emails, stock levels and the order record afterward. You receive a simple pass or fail list with screenshots, and we report anything that needs fixing so you can act or ask us to repair it.

faq: Will test orders charge real cards?
We use test mode or a zero value discount wherever your payment provider allows it. If a real small order is needed, we ask you first and refund it immediately.
Will test orders mess up my reports?
We tag every test order clearly and cancel them afterward, so they can be filtered out. We tell you exactly which orders to ignore in your reports.
Do you fix any problems found?
The test shows what fails. We include fix notes, and we can repair the problems in a separate order, or you can give the notes to your developer.
How often should checkout be tested?
After a theme change, an app update, a new payment method or a platform change. The Premium checklist shows your team how to do the same test quickly.
